answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round.
